_comment: WebBridge evaluate payload behind the YU-143 24px Agent OSS icon decision, plus the numbers it produced. Reproduce with: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:10086/command -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @, after a cdp Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride for the target viewport. It mutates the four Agent OSS width/height attributes in the live DOM, measures, then restores them, so it is safe to run against a real page.
_measured_on: 2026-09-26, main at 947e19f (v2.3), live github.com/Bruce-Yii in Microsoft Edge, at 390px and again at 320px with identical results

_measured_results.note: rows is how many lines the 2x2 occupies. 2 is correct. The cell is fixed at 84px so these numbers are identical at 320px and 390px.
_measured_results.decision: 24px. The 84px cell is a preferred width under table-layout:auto, not guaranteed, so the useful question is how far the cell can shrink before the 2x2 breaks: 24px tolerates 79px, 26px only 83px. 25px is the ceiling if someone later wants more.

_also_confirmed_by_measurement: RAGFlow must stay non-square: 23x24. GitHub's sanitiser rewrites width/height into style="height:auto;max-height:24px;aspect-ratio:23 / 24", so a square 24x24 would emit aspect-ratio 24/24 and squash the mark. Verified against api.github.com/markdown on the real README.

The v2.4 preview's blob page reported naturalWidth 0 for every external image, including the repository's own streak.svg, while a control load of the live profile reported zero broken images. That was a blob-pane image-loading artefact in that session, not a content regression, which is why v2.4 image verification was repeated on the live profile after pushing.
